body.name: rational plug-in estimator
body.construction: If \(\min_{1\le j\le r}|Q_{F,j}(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)|>0\), set \(\widehat\theta_G=F_G(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)\) and obtain \(\widehat V_F\) by empirical averaging of the plug-in influence vectors. If any \(Q_{F,j}(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)=0\), adopt the explicit sample-evaluation convention \(F_G(\operatorname{vech}\widehat\Sigma)=\widehat\theta_G=0_r\) and \(\widehat V_F=0_{r\times r}\).
